author: satanworker
body: Let's spend more time here, why is it required to have a server of any sort? Does that server hold the github tokens
quote: - sync hub: a dumb room router that doesn't know about CRDTs. Room = repo. Tabs mesh-sync through it, using our own ~80-line automerge-repo `NetworkAdapter` (multi-peer, routes by `targetId`). We can't use the stock websocket adapter: it assumes a single remote peer that is itself an automerge-repo server. The first message carries the GitHub token; the hub admits a tab only with push access to the room's repo (checked via the GitHub API, cached briefly). Read-only viewers get no live sync, because any sync peer can inject ops that a writer later
